resources.string: Scan a QR code or check copied text in one tap
Tap the floating shield to check any message, link or QR code on screen

Shows a floating Guardian button over other apps. When you tap it, Guardian reads the text on the screen and looks for QR codes, checks them on this phone for scam warning signs, and shows the result. If website checks are on, Guardian also reads only the address bar of your browser to warn you about risky websites. Guardian does not read your screen at any other time, and password fields are never read.
